BARD-SONG.title: Song
BARD-SONG.description: Only one Song plays at a time. Starting a new Song ends the old one and triggers its [gold]Finale[/gold]. Every other card you play adds a [gold]Verse[/gold] (max 15). At the start of your turn its [gold]Refrain[/gold] triggers; Refrains grow as Verses build up.
BARD-VERSE.title: Verse
BARD-VERSE.description: Your current [gold]Song[/gold] grows by one Verse for every non-Song card you play (max 15). Finales scale with Verses.
